subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Ethical Sourcing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Ethical Sourcing usable.

hook.text: Cobalt in your phone battery may have been mined by a child in Congo. Ethical sourcing asks: do you know?

buildup.text: Ethical sourcing ensures that products are obtained responsibly—without exploitation, abuse, or harm.

discovery.text: It covers labor conditions, fair wages, environmental impact, and community effects across the supply chain.

twist.text: Most companies lack visibility beyond their direct suppliers. Tier 2 and 3 violations stay hidden.

climax.text: Consumer pressure and regulation are forcing companies to trace and verify ethics at every tier.

punchline.text: If you don't know where it came from, you can't know how.

quiz.question: What does ethical sourcing ensure?
options: Products are obtained without exploitation or harm
